name: Raw Meat
description: A cut of fresh game, still bloody. Cook it, or salt it into jerky.
notes: Taken from beasts: boars, deer, wolves and bears.
Keeps you fed 2 hours. Eaten raw, it may give you food poisoning (Constitution save, DC 10).
Spoils in 12 hours: cook it at a fire (or have an innkeeper cook it), or salt it into jerky.
